fold_model_rule: Instantiate a clean pivot-01 strategy in every fold. It has no learned coefficients; each byte-distinct fold artifact binds exact source/config/seed, 24h schedule, fold dates, empty learned-state declaration, and fresh-state proof.
label_rule: No forward label enters strategy fitting. Organizer performance labels begin strictly after each decision and are used only for fold scoring.
purge_rule: The seven-day gap between each expanding training end and test start exceeds the 24h score/holding horizon; no test observation is used for a parameter or preprocessing choice.
selection_rule: Register the exact family and candidate before producing any fold result. Stitched out-of-fold evidence is evaluated only by the organizer and may not be replaced with slices from one fitted backtest.
